pattern: てしょうがない・てしかたがない
aliases: te shou ga nai/te shikata ga nai
purpose: Describe an intense feeling or sensation that is hard to control.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Verb / い-adjective て-form; な-adjective + で + しょうがない / しかたがない
I cannot stop wondering about the result.
I feel terribly lonely on nights alone.
formation: Verb / い-adjective て-form; な-adjective + で + しょうがない / しかたがない
restrictions: Usually subjective feelings and sensations, not a request or obligation.
mistake: 寒くてしかたがない describes intense cold; てもしかたがない instead evaluates an action as futile.
